pages: Notice: during Ramadan the west entrance opens at 7 in the morning.
The reading room closes early on 9 May for maintenance work.
Lost keys are reported to the building supervisor at extension 204.

cases.question: In what year did the library open its doors, and how many books were in the collection?
cases.fact: The library opened its doors on 14 March 1998 with a collection of 4200 books.

cases.question: How many seats does the reading room have?
cases.fact: The reading room on the first floor seats 86 people.

cases.question: How long do loans run, and how many days does a renewal add?
cases.fact: Loans run for 21 days; a renewal adds another 14 days.

cases.question: What is the overdue fine per day?
cases.fact: The overdue fine is 0.25 dinars per day per book, capped at 12 dinars.

cases.question: How much does a non resident card cost a year?
cases.fact: Membership is free for residents; a non resident card costs 35 dinars a year.

cases.question: What temperature and humidity are kept in the archive room?
cases.fact: The archive room keeps a constant 18 degrees Celsius and 45 percent humidity.

cases.question: What are the names of the 3D printers in the maker space?
cases.fact: The maker space has two 3D printers named Castor and Pollux.

cases.question: When did head librarian Dana Farah join?
cases.fact: Head librarian Dana Farah joined in April 2016.

cases.question: Who handles book binding and repair?
cases.fact: Book binding and repair goes to the Falcon Press workshop, order code FP-55.

cases.question: How much did the roof renewal cost?
cases.fact: The roof was renewed in the summer of 2019 at a cost of 74000 dinars.

cases.question: What is the annual budget for 2026?
cases.fact: The annual budget for 2026 is 310000 dinars.

cases.question: How much is the events budget for 2026?
cases.fact: The events budget for 2026 is 9500 dinars.

cases.question: How much does a lost card cost to replace?
cases.fact: A lost card is replaced for 2 dinars.

cases.question: When is the annual book sale held?
cases.fact: The annual book sale is held on the first weekend of June.
